postInstall.message:
user module installed.

Wire up your layout (pos-app class, common-styling init, notifications) and
optionally set the default role, override RBAC permissions, and create a
superadmin, all in one interactive step:

  pos-cli generate run modules/user/generators/install

Prefer to wire things up by hand? See the module README, Setup section, for the manual steps:
https://github.com/Platform-OS/pos-modules/blob/master/pos-module-user/README.md
